name: HisabCalc – Loan, Zakat, BMI & Age Calculators
author: tfjishan

sections.description:
HisabCalc gives you eight ready-made calculators that you can drop into any post, page or widget with a block or a shortcode. Everything is calculated inside the visitor’s browser, so the pages stay fast and no personal data ever leaves the reader’s device.

Included calculators

  • Loan / EMI calculator – monthly instalment, total payable, total interest, plus a year-by-year breakdown table.
  • Mortgage / home loan calculator – property price, down payment, monthly payment and the real total cost.
  • Zakat calculator – gold, silver, cash, business stock, receivables and debts, with the 2.5% zakat and a nisab check.
  • Compound interest / FDR maturity – what a lump sum becomes at a fixed rate, with yearly, half-yearly, quarterly or monthly compounding.
  • Monthly savings / DPS – what a monthly deposit grows into over time.
  • BMI calculator – with both WHO and South Asian cut-off points, plus the healthy weight range for the visitor’s height.
  • Percentage calculator – five everyday percentage questions in one: percent of a number, what percent, percentage change, increase and decrease.
  • Age calculator – exact age in years, months and days, total days and the countdown to the next birthday.

Why people keep it installed

  • Fast. One small CSS file and two small scripts. No jQuery, no external requests, no fonts to download.
  • Private by design. Nothing is posted to your server and nothing is stored. There is no tracking in the plugin.
  • Responsive. Works on a 320px phone and inside a full-width block.
  • Theme friendly. Colours come from the customiser-style accent setting, and a dark-mode palette follows the visitor’s system preference.
  • Translatable. Every label can be translated into your own language.
  • SEO-friendly output. Results appear instantly on the page, which keeps visitors on the page longer.

How to add a calculator

  1. Edit a post or page and click the + button, then search for “HisabCalc”.
  2. Pick the calculator you want from the block sidebar.
  3. Or use a shortcode: [hisabcalc id="loan-emi"], [hisabcalc id="zakat"], [hisabcalc id="bmi"].

Available ids: loan-emi, mortgage, zakat, compound-interest, dps, bmi, percentage, age.

Settings

Under Settings > HisabCalc you can choose the currency, the number format locale, how many decimal places to show, the accent colour and whether the small credit line is displayed.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the hisabcalc folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add the HisabCalc Calculator block to a post, or paste [hisabcalc id="loan-emi"].
sections.faq:
Is any data sent to my server?

No. All calculations run in the visitor’s browser with plain JavaScript. The plugin makes no external requests and stores nothing.

Can I use several calculators on one page?

Yes. Add as many blocks as you like; they all run independently.

Do the numbers use my local currency and number format?

Yes. Set the currency and locale under Settings > HisabCalc. If your site language is Bangla, the taka (BDT) is selected automatically.

Can I use it with the Classic editor or a page builder?

Yes. Use the shortcode [hisabcalc id="zakat"] in the Classic editor, or a shortcode/text block in Elementor, Divi, WPBakery and similar builders. Theme authors can also call hisabcalc_the_calculator( 'loan-emi' ) in a template.

Are the results financial advice?

No. Every calculator is an estimate for planning. Confirm final figures with your bank, employer, tax adviser or doctor.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Renamed the plugin to HisabCalc, as requested during the WordPress.org review.
  • The bundled translation files were removed from the package; translations are delivered by translate.wordpress.org.

1.0.1

  • Shortened the readme short description so the directory does not truncate it.

1.0.0

  • First release with eight calculators: loan/EMI, mortgage, zakat, compound interest, DPS, BMI, percentage and age.
  • Gutenberg block plus shortcode.
  • Currency, locale, decimals, accent colour and credit-line settings.
  • Dark-mode palette and full translation support.
